# std/url

URL parsing and manipulation.

```milo
from "std/url" import { Url }
```

## Example

```milo
let url = Url.parse("https://example.com:8080/api?name=milo&v=1#top")!
print(url.scheme)  // https
print(url.host)    // example.com
print(url.port)    // 8080

match url.queryGet("name") {
    Option.Some(val) => print(val),  // milo
    Option.None => {},
}
```

## API reference

### `Url`

```milo
pub struct Url
```

A parsed URL, split into its components. `raw` keeps the original string.

Fields: `scheme: string`, `host: string`, `port: i32`, `path: string`, `query: string`, `fragment: string`, `raw: string`.

#### `Url.parse`

```milo
fn Url.parse(s: string): Result<Url>
```

Parse a URL string into its components.

#### `Url.queryGet`

```milo
fn Url.queryGet(self: &Url, key: &string): Option<string>
```

The value of query parameter `key`, or None if the query has no such key.

#### `Url.toString`

```milo
fn Url.toString(self: &Url): string
```

Reassemble the URL from its components.
